decisions.reason: As a 2018 extension of the firm’s core wafer-processing capabilities into a growing semiconductor market, its technical and commercial potential is still unresolved and the cost of keeping this close-to-core option open is likely modest relative to its upside.

The carrier wafer for smaller diameters directly complements the established substrate business, serves clear customer handling needs, and with no adverse market signal yet in a growing industry it is rational to preserve this low-risk option for further learning.
